# Structural Gate Template

This is an optional Heavy/formal-profile packet completeness check. It is not a
universal gate, technical review, verdict, or acceptance decision.

```markdown
Status: `PASS`, `REPAIR_REQUIRED`, or `BLOCKED`
Profile authority:
Packet / candidate reference:
Required fields present:
Missing or contradictory fields:
Authority / permission / scope preserved:
Required evidence references present:
Repair boundary or next owner:
```

Forward to the selected review only on `PASS`. Packet wording/status/EOF repair
closes with a direct focused check; semantic repair receives the affected
review required by the active profile.
